name: Fishing Net's Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: When an enemy piece is trapped, skip the enemy's turn.
description: A rare trap-focused gambit: whenever an enemy piece gets trapped (hunter tiles included), the enemy's next turn is skipped, turning every trap into free tempo. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

gambits.name: Fishing Net's Gambit
gambits.description: When an enemy piece is <color=◊>TRAPPED</color>, skip the enemy's turn.
